messages:
jen: Heads-up - Sparrow Labs (early-stage AI infra) asked for an expanded trial credit. They want to run a 30d POC that includes heavy embedding indexing + a small prod pilot. Can we fast-track a promo?
ravi: What are the rough volumes and which models/regions? Need numbers for Deal Desk sizing.
jen: Estimate: ~300k tokens/week + 1.2M embeddings over 30 days. US-central region, using our mid-tier open-model. They also mentioned nightly bulk indexing jobs.
sam-deals: Our standard startup promo is $4k for 60d. Anything above needs Deal Desk + Finance approval. If they want more, propose a conversion path to committed spend post-trial.
marta-cs: POC details: index ~40M small docs, run similarity + rerank, demo mid-month. We need staging keys, elevated embedding quota, and prefix cache enabled. Their stress test is planned next Wednesday.
ops-bot: Credit request created: CR-5981. Attached: Sparrow_SSQ.pdf. Routed to #deal-desk.
tayla-legal: Quick flag: SSQ includes requests to retain POC data for 9 months. We typically avoid retention exceptions without a signed addendum. If credits are increased, require a short addendum limiting retention and granting audit rights.
ravi: Quick cost sketch: ```
# rough calc
tokens_week = 300000
weeks = 4
cost_per_1k_tokens = 0.003
token_cost = tokens_week * weeks / 1000 * cost_per_1k_tokens
embeddings = 1200000
embed_unit_cost = 0.0001
embed_cost = embeddings * embed_unit_cost
total_unit_cost = token_cost + embed_cost
```
ravi: That shows only a few hundred dollars in unit costs, but the indexing + GPU workload and burst infra mean promo exposure should be larger.
jen: Sparrow asked for $12k credits to cover indexing + pilot. I'd prefer a middle ground: $8k / 45d with a conversion clause: if they convert to a committed plan within 90d, X% of unused credits convert to invoice credit. Thoughts?
sam-deals: @olivia-dealdesk can you review? Finance needs to accept promo risk and legal sign-off on addendum.
olivia-dealdesk: I can approve a limited promo. Proposed decision: $8,000 free credits, 45d validity, require MSA addendum covering retention <=180d and SOC2 notice. Condition: credits void if no paid commit >= $1,500/mo within 90d after trial end. Also require CS engagement and staging support ack.
jen: That would unblock them. Can we provision keys + quota today?
marta-cs: I can enable staging keys once deal desk & ops confirm quota increase. Will schedule infra for the stress window.
ops-bot: Quota ticket INF-8021 opened for elevated embedding quota and burst GPUs. ETA: 36h.
tayla-legal: I'll draft the addendum and send to Sparrow's counsel. Note: no retention exception beyond 180 days without security sign-off.
olivia-dealdesk: Added approval to the dealsheet and marked CR-5981 as approved pending addendum. Noted conversion clause for AE to present. :white_check_mark:
jen: Thanks all 97 I'll confirm with Sparrow and schedule the kickoff.
jen: (follow-up) Sparrow asked if promo can be extended if they sign a 12mo commit up-front. I said we'd apply a conversion credit evaluation on a case-by-case basis and they'd need deal desk review.
olivia-dealdesk: AEMs can request conversion on signed commits; route to deal-desk with revenue projections.
jen: Closing thread 97 will update dealsheet when they sign.
